subject: Physics
source_note: External demand evidence from NEETPrep Mini Q Bank - Motion in a Plane, Relative Motion filter. Six text-visible questions now map cleanly to canonical capabilities after Vector Addition/Decomposition completion. External questions remain transient and are not promoted to Core2/source custody.

questions.note: Walking observer with vertical rain; requires relative velocity as a vector and perpendicular-component magnitude.
Boat and water velocities are both given in the ground frame; learner must subtract in the correct observer order.
Symbolic rain-versus-runner version of perpendicular relative-velocity magnitude.
River crossing directly opposite; compose swimmer-relative and current velocities and cancel the along-river component before using the relative-motion result.
Shortest-path river crossing; impose the perpendicular-resultant constraint, cancel the unwanted component, then use the right-triangle magnitude relation where required.
Perpendicular chase/intercept geometry; relative frame plus right-triangle relation is required to obtain catch time.
